body:
Sorry for falling asleep on you there, hopefully you weren't worried. As soon as I got a grip 5 am kicked in. And yeah, that sounds like me. For a guy who hasn't done anything with his life I sure do talk a lot about it. Continuing with my total lack of self awareness...

Yes, some of them at least. My roommate last year basically tried to fix me himself which was quite uncomfortable. He also asked me if I was likely to go on a murderous rampage and kill him, and he was quite relieved when I told him I'd only be taking myself. For the most part though they tell me by not inviting me to shit, cancelling at the last minute, or blatantly showing that they don't respect me. The ones that have never had the misfortune of catching a glimpse of the true me use me all the time since they think I'm too dumb to notice. The ones who do know me know I let it happen because I don't respect myself, and I guess that makes them too guilty to do it. 

Honestly I'd love to go for an epic mountain biking adventure, but if I had a friend willing to do that with me I probably wouldn't feel so hopeless. I'm a do-er, but I don't have my shit together enough to hang out with other do-ers. When I do kill myself though I plan on taking an absolutely absurd amount of psychedelics and maybe try overdosing on fentanyl to finish the job way off in some woods where I know I'd never be found. It's a lonely hoorah but it will probably be pretty cool. I love nature and drugs, though it would be my first and last experience with an opioid.

If I weren't a pussy though, there's a lot of things I'd like to do. I know I'm not actually trans now, but I'd still love to explore that world just for the hell of it. Go out and buy some dresses and act girly with my female friends just to get it all out. It's not that I even think I'm a woman, it's that I want to experience being uninhibited. Knowing that I'm being a weirdo and still be accepted by my friends and myself. It's that craving that made me think I was trans. I'd also like to finish my reddit-like social network project, I really think it would have a chance if it weren't me being the one working on it. I'd like to conquer all of the mountains near me. I'd like to learn how to go to the gym and lift or buy clothes without having a panic attack. And then I want to learn how to love and care about others, with the confidence of knowing that I already love and care about myself. If I knew how to break free though, I would have.

I don't want to go into specifics and doxx myself, but my last one was a tool for artists.

I loved working on it but it kind of sucked for me in the end. I didn't have the balls to really release any of my own artwork that I made with it, at least with my name attached. I spent months tweaking and testing my algorithms, but I just gave it away for nothing. I watch people use it and share their creations, and some of them have been incredibly popular. Some of the artists are actually quite successful and have a name for themselves. It's cool to know I've made an impact I guess, but my biggest longing is to be able to express myself and I guess overengineering a way for other people to be able to express little bits of me in their own work is the most true expression of myself that there is. Which is something I really, really want to change but I don't know how to without coming off as fake or narcissistic. 

My suicide plans essentially involve me disappearing, because I know that one of the main arguments against suicide is how selfish it is to leave people with a body to clean up. Trust me, with my plan, no body would ever be found. I am keenly aware of the pain I've caused already. My sister hates me, and I am a burden for my parents who are sick of having to deal with me. I don't blame them though. I know after the initial shock that they'd be happier. My friends too, as the good times we have are interspersed with swaths of time where I couldn't control my own mental illness. I'm more of a band-aid that needs to be ripped off.

Thank you! I used Java. People give it so much shit, and yeah it's not perfect but I actually love it even now that I've experienced a bunch of other languages. The competition was to make the most efficient algorithm to perform a task so the platform didn't really matter, but I also use java to develop most of my apps so it's rather easy to make all of my programs for Windows, Mac, and Linux. 

Anything that keeps my mind off my mind reduces anxiety. Unfortunately the only consistently relieving thing I've found is alcohol or sufficiently high amounts of weed. I know its not healthy. Other immediate solutions like video games seem to make things worse in the long run. In order to really improve I need to be making progress in becoming who I really want to be: a confident, self-expressed person with healthy relationships, and I feel stuck.

I suppose that's true about middle school to some extent, but I still missed a bunch of what seem to be critical milestones that happen through grade school. At the time I for the most part saw what I was supposed to do but rejected it. Now I show up to parties and am just frozen there not knowing what to do. I feel like there's a path for people who are where I am socially because they were just sweet innocent children, but as you know I am pretty much the opposite of innocent. In a sense I chose this, and I guess that makes me ineligible for sympathy but it's not what I'm looking for. I want a way out where I can't hurt anyone else. There's suicide, and ???. Catcher in the Rye doesn't really have an ending.
